overview.about: The British Grand Prix at Silverstone hosted the very first round of the Formula 1 World Championship in 1950, and no event has a stronger claim to be the sport's home. The fast, flowing corners - Maggotts, Becketts, Copse - reward brave, committed driving, and the grandstands are among the loudest on the calendar. Lewis Hamilton's nine wins here are an outright record for any single Grand Prix. The 2027 race is on 2-4 July.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 British Grand Prix runs 2-4 July at Silverstone, a high-speed permanent circuit north of London. It regularly draws the biggest race-day crowd of the F1 season, and the home fans have had plenty to cheer with British drivers dominating its recent history.

Silverstone remains the British home of the championship and its high-speed layout is known for fast, flowing corners rather than a street-circuit rhythm.
